name: Flooded Stormwater Convergence · Fire
primary:
A widening stream (up to 3 blocks wide) hits everyone in front of you; in instant mode it keeps going while held:
• Damage 2.25 ❤ lightning + 2 ❤ fire (lightning ×2 on wet, fire ×0.5 on wet)
• Soaked for 16.5 s and leaves a puddle
• Knockback
• Charge 63: weakness, stuns for 1 s at 65 charge (×2 on wet)
• Then the lightning jumps onward: up to 8 targets in a row, jumps up to 6 blocks, 2.25 ❤ and 40 charge each (×2 damage and longer jumps on wet, ×1.5 range in puddles)
• Heals 1.75 ❤
• Regeneration: +0.5 ❤ every 2 s for 9 s
• Growth: up to 5 nearby blocks — crops +2 stages, dirt turns to grass, roots grow upward
• Heat: sets on fire for 13.5 s (wet targets just dry off), thaws; melts ice and burns roots
